parent_objective: synthesize source-intervention materialization branch after ten milestones
blocked_by: branch synthesis cadence reached after M1285
supersedes: continuing source-intervention materialization branch with another narrow milestone

public_gates: M1286 must not use private holdout
M1286 must decide continue pivot stop or promote_to_next_branch
M1286 must open the next branch only if evidence supports it
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add another narrow source-history milestone before synthesis
do not claim high-fidelity validation from compact four-wheel source artifacts

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: synthesizes M1276-M1285 source intervention and source-history evidence and chooses the next branch
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: branch synthesis only; no training, promotion, private-holdout, paper-level, closed-loop, high-fidelity, or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop same branch after synthesis unless decision explicitly continues
stop if synthesis omits supported and falsified claims
stop if next branch decision is not explicit
fallback_plan: if source-history objective path is promising, promote_to_next_branch with a new branch name
if evidence is insufficient, pivot to corpus repair or richer prefix design
if source path is exhausted, stop and archive branch
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1285 completed the tenth milestone in the branch

admission_evidence: M1283 policy gate was weak but finite
M1285 exact objective evaluator passed with finite residuals
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
one next manifest if synthesis opens a new branch
next_stage_criteria: supported and falsified claims are documented

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: Synthesis must preserve the distinction between action-level source-history diagnostics and closed-loop self-identification proof.
history_necessity_tests: do not convert weak action-level signal into self-ID claim
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: M1283 weak action-level signal must remain negative evidence that blocks PPO until objective-only evidence improves.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: The M1276-M1285 branch can be synthesized into a clear next-branch decision without overclaiming or continuing narrow work past cadence.
success_criteria: synthesis chooses the next branch decision
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: synthesis continues same branch without decision
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs

supported_claims: clean preferred/rejected source intervention artifacts exist
branch-specific source response histories and wrong-history swaps are valid
policy-side source-history gate and exact objective evaluator are implemented
exact source-history residual is finite and large
falsified_claims: direct current-frame policy training is valid
current public-gate checkpoint already uses source histories correctly
nonzero action movement is enough for PPO admission

decision_rule: M1286 passes if it synthesizes the branch and chooses an explicit next branch without training or overclaiming.
